name: LongGenBench
description: LongGenBench is a synthetic benchmark designed to evaluate the long-context generation capabilities of large language models. It allows flexible configuration of generation context lengths and requires models to generate coherent, contextually accurate long-form answers.
reputation: A recent synthetic benchmark from the long-context generation literature that is still emerging and has limited but growing adoption in long-context LLM evaluation.
notes: Focuses on generation rather than retrieval; shows performance degradation in long-context generation for various LLMs.
